body: UTTAMSUGAR beat-Nifty500 rule says 'Yahoo adjusted closes' while its base 348.50 is the plain close; interpret as split-adjusted (no dividends) to match the base and all other price calls. US-PNC Q4 NII: spec waits for the 10-K; if the 10-K figure differs from the January release, the release (the rule's wording) governs. Both fixed 25-Nov-2026 before any resolution.
title: Scoreboard clarifications before season: Yahoo 'adjusted' = split-adjusted; PNC NII resolves from 10-K, release governs if they differ
